tools.name: water_damage_add_atmosphere_readings
tools.description: Add affected/unaffected/outside/interior/exterior atmosphere readings with explicit units and observedAt per reading.

tools.name: water_damage_add_daily_log
tools.description: Add a single daily drying log for an observed day with explicit observedAt and enteredAt timestamps.

tools.name: water_damage_add_dehumidifier_readings
tools.description: Add dehumidifier intake/outlet temp and RH readings for performance calculation.

tools.name: water_damage_add_material_readings
tools.description: Add material moisture readings by room with optional pin number and dry standard comparison.

tools.name: water_damage_add_note
tools.description: Add a field note or exception to the job timeline with optional room scope.

tools.name: water_damage_add_room
tools.description: Add an affected or unaffected room/area to the job structure.

tools.name: water_damage_add_zone
tools.description: Add a drying zone/chamber covering one or more rooms.

tools.name: water_damage_append_assumption_ledger_entry
tools.description: Append an assumption or exception_note to the ledger. Prior entries are never rewritten; use supersedesEntryId to chain corrections.

tools.name: water_damage_archive_job
tools.description: Soft-archive a water damage job. Archived jobs remain readable but are hidden from default lists.

tools.name: water_damage_backfill_daily_logs
tools.description: Create one daily log per observed day from a multi-day backfill upload. Preserves distinct observedAt and enteredAt per day — never copies a single upload timestamp across days.

tools.name: water_damage_build_estimate_ready_handoff
tools.description: Build source-backed estimate line candidates (service codes, units, quantities, assumptions) for mitigation or repair. No prices — Estimator owns pricing.

tools.name: water_damage_build_mitigation_rationale
tools.description: Build evidence-backed mitigation rationale arguments from job snapshot facts linked to S500 reference topics. Never fabricates exact S500 citations for pending topics.

tools.name: water_damage_calculate_dehumidifier_performance
tools.description: Evaluate dehumidifier performance for equipment on a job (ok, weak, negative flags) from stored or supplied readings.

tools.name: water_damage_calculate_grain_depression
tools.description: Calculate grain depression from dehumidifier intake and outlet temp/RH readings.

tools.name: water_damage_calculate_psychrometrics
tools.description: Calculate GPP, dew point, and vapor pressure from dry-bulb temp (°F) and RH (%). Returns formula id, source id, and verification status.

tools.name: water_damage_capture_evidence_packet
tools.description: Capture a new immutable evidence packet version: checklist, S500 rationale, ledger snapshot, and submitted artifact refs.

tools.name: water_damage_correlate_voice_photo_timeline
tools.description: Suggest alignments between voice transcript segments and photos/readings by capture time and room labels. Low-confidence associations require user confirmation.

tools.name: water_damage_create_estimator_draft
tools.description: Create an estimator draft estimate linked to a pricing handoff snapshot. Failed handoffs do not mutate the factual job record.

tools.name: water_damage_create_job
tools.description: Create a new water damage mitigation job. Requires jobNumber; optionally accepts claim/property/contact and loss-classification fields. Returns the job record with id for follow-up setup and field capture.

tools.name: water_damage_create_moisture_map
tools.description: Create a room moisture map from a wide-angle anchor photo. Pins are numbered stably per room across daily logs.

tools.name: water_damage_create_pricing_handoff
tools.description: Create a factual scope snapshot for pricing handoff (mitigation, mold_remediation, demo_scope, rebuild_estimate). No prices — estimator owns pricing.

tools.name: water_damage_create_visit
tools.description: Record a site visit with observedAt, source (field_live, backfill, ai_assisted), technician, and access outcome.

tools.name: water_damage_export_report_pdf
tools.description: Generate a PDF report artifact and return a download URL (not raw bytes). Persists WaterDamageReportArtifact with readiness snapshot.

tools.name: water_damage_get_assumptions_ledger
tools.description: Get the append-only assumptions/exceptions ledger for carrier claim review.

tools.name: water_damage_get_calculation_sources
tools.description: List public standards sources, formula ids, and verification status for water damage calculations.

tools.name: water_damage_get_claim_approval_checklist
tools.description: Get non-blocking claim approval soft checklist with photo prompt coverage by room/stage and narrative gaps.

tools.name: water_damage_get_claim_narrative
tools.description: Get claim narrative onboarding questions, merged answers (operator + derived), and completion status.

tools.name: water_damage_get_claim_outcome
tools.description: Get a single carrier claim outcome with linked evidence/estimate refs.

tools.name: water_damage_get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Get dashboard cards: setup completeness, drying progress, last observed day, backfill flags, missing data, and report readiness.

tools.name: water_damage_get_equipment_recommendations
tools.description: Get equipment sizing recommendations for a zone or room. Unverified IICRC sizing rules are labeled pending_confirmation.

tools.name: water_damage_get_evidence_packet
tools.description: Get a specific evidence packet version with full snapshot content and content hash.

tools.name: water_damage_get_job
tools.description: Get a water damage job by id, including setup summary and linked records when available.

tools.name: water_damage_get_missing_data
tools.description: List missing required readings, photos, logs, and unverified moisture pins for the job. Never invents values.

tools.name: water_damage_get_report_readiness
tools.description: Get report readiness dimensions and blocked reasons. Missing data must be explicit — never fabricated.

tools.name: water_damage_get_setup_checklist
tools.description: Get first-visit setup checklist completion for a job (rooms, zones, claim basics, initial photos/readings gaps).

tools.name: water_damage_get_standards_reference_status
tools.description: List IICRC S500 reference topics with controlled verification status (verified vs pending_confirmation). Refuses exact section/page citations for pending topics.

tools.name: water_damage_list_carrier_objections
tools.description: List carrier objections for a job, optionally filtered by outcomeId query param.

tools.name: water_damage_list_claim_outcomes
tools.description: List append-only carrier claim outcomes for a job (newest first). Outcome rows are immutable after capture.

tools.name: water_damage_list_evidence_packets
tools.description: List versioned evidence packet snapshots for a job (newest first). Packet content is immutable after capture.

tools.name: water_damage_list_jobs
tools.description: List water damage jobs for the current user. Optional status filter: active, archived, or all.

tools.name: water_damage_list_photos
tools.description: List photos for a job with optional room or kind filters.

tools.name: water_damage_preview_report
tools.description: Preview structured report sections for a mode before PDF export. Refuses report-ready output when critical data is missing unless explicitly excepted.

tools.name: water_damage_reconstruct_submitted_artifacts
tools.description: Reconstruct submitted artifact references from a persisted evidence packet version.

tools.name: water_damage_record_carrier_objection
tools.description: Record a lightweight carrier objection tied to a claim outcome. Links to evidence packets, assumptions, references, and estimate lines without mutating prior records.

tools.name: water_damage_record_claim_outcome
tools.description: Record an append-only carrier claim outcome (accepted, adjusted, denied) linked to evidence packets, assumptions, S500 topics, and estimate lines. Prior outcomes are never rewritten — use supersedesOutcomeId to chain corrections.

tools.name: water_damage_record_photo_exception
tools.description: Record an explicit missing-photo exception for a photo prompt dimension (e.g. wide_photo:room-id).

tools.name: water_damage_record_pin_readings
tools.description: Record a daily material reading against a stable pin number on a moisture map.

tools.name: water_damage_record_suggestion_feedback
tools.description: Append suggestion feedback for future claim-learning (helpful / not_helpful / partially_helpful). Never mutates historical outcomes or objections.

tools.name: water_damage_set_claim_basics
tools.description: Set claim/job basics: job number, claim number, insured, property, loss date, source, IICRC category (1-3), and water class (1-4).

tools.name: water_damage_set_loss_classification
tools.description: Set or update loss source, IICRC category/class, and loss date without replacing other claim fields.

tools.name: water_damage_set_property_contact_carrier
tools.description: Set property address, onsite contact, and carrier/adjuster contact fields for the job.

tools.name: water_damage_suggest_moisture_pins
tools.description: AI-suggest pin locations from close-up reading photos, voice notes, and EXIF timing. Suggestions start unverified.

tools.name: water_damage_transcribe_voice_note
tools.description: Transcribe a voice note with segment timestamps. Transcript-derived facts require confirmation before report-ready use.

tools.name: water_damage_update_assumption_ledger_review
tools.description: Transition review status on a ledger entry (open → accepted/disputed/withdrawn). Statement text is immutable.

tools.name: water_damage_update_claim_narrative
tools.description: Upsert operator claim narrative answers with field-recorded provenance.

tools.name: water_damage_update_daily_log
tools.description: Update daily log completeness, notes, or timestamps. Does not fabricate missing readings.

tools.name: water_damage_update_equipment_status
tools.description: Update equipment placement status (active, moved, removed) with optional room/zone and timestamps.

tools.name: water_damage_update_evidence_packet_review
tools.description: Transition evidence packet review status (draft → submitted → under_review → approved/needs_revision). Packet body is never mutated.

tools.name: water_damage_update_job
tools.description: Update job metadata (jobNumber, status, claim/property/contact, and loss-classification fields). Does not replace field readings.

tools.name: water_damage_update_room
tools.description: Update room name, materials, affected status, or dry-standard notes.

tools.name: water_damage_update_zone
tools.description: Update zone name, covered rooms, or status.

tools.name: water_damage_upload_photo_metadata
tools.description: Register photo metadata (artifact URL, kind, room/zone, capture and entered timestamps). Does not upload binary — use Kynver media upload first.

tools.name: water_damage_upload_voice_note
tools.description: Register a voice note artifact with optional room context and capture timestamp.

tools.name: water_damage_verify_moisture_pins
tools.description: Verify, correct, or exclude moisture map pins. Excluded pins require excludeReason for report readiness.
